notes.title: The v1.2 update for Blacksmith: Ignite the Forge has just landed!
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45227734/1f2fdb805f4271e65fb47a4565bfcf90e739b0f1.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Take a look at the changelog below, and get your hammers ready to craft![/b] [/p][h2]General changes:[/h2][list][*][p][b]More voiceovers[/b] – We’ve added a variety of new lines for your trusty advisor, who now appears more often to share his wisdom.[/p][/*][*][p] [b]Sharpening changes[/b] – Failure is now less punishing: failed sharpening attempts reduce sharpness by 1 instead of resetting it to 0. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Alloy Machine tooltips[/b] – Added more tooltips so you can easily check what an enchantment does or view details of an inserted weapon template.  [/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h2]Bug fixes: [/h2][list][*][p]Fixed a bug causing tooltips in the marketplace to cover items. [/p][/*][*][p]Improved overall code stability.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Another patch has gone live: version v1.1!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45227734/319cf6db72dd33eba53fac7fba62ac2251d523dd.jpg[/img]

See the full list of changes below.

[list]
[*] The Alloy Machine now ignores empty slots when matching ore bonuses—no more alloy recipes lost due to additional machine slots.
[*] You can now gain multiple bonuses of the same type in the Alloy Machine.
[*] All followers now have an additional level-up skill option.
[*] Followers are now sorted so that your most-used dwarves appear at the top of the list.
[*] You can now see which ores can be found on your current mine level.
[*] Added a rune tutorial to the Help button in the room with the Runic Machine.
[/list]

Bug fixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug causing weapons to behave strangely after sharpening.
[*] Improved scroll speed for inventory and follower panels.
[*] Fixed a bug with saving the game after beating the last boss.
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.2
notes.content:
A fix for the save wipe issue has just been released. We discovered that the problem only affected players who, after the recent update, returned to the main menu and exited the game from there. Those who quit the game directly during gameplay were not affected.

Unfortunately, there's no way for us to recover any lost save files. We're truly sorry for the inconvenience this has caused.

notes.title: Untitled
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45227734/3311c0f53236f48487e96b7f1a2533b3c8ec711f.jpg[/img]

[h2]Hello, Blacksmiths! [/h2]
Inspired by the community feedback, we’re introducing the first small patch for Blacksmith: Ignite the Forge. Version 1.0.1 includes the following changes:

[list]
[*] Progress is now automatically saved when returning to the main menu or exiting the game. No more lost progress (sorry!).
[*] The sharpening minigame has been streamlined. Just a single click to start, no more holding the mouse button or accidental misclicks.
[*] The balance of sharpening has been adjusted. It takes less time to sharpen the weapon, but it is slightly more difficult.
[*] Adjusted daily chaos difficulty and rewards across all acts for a more consistent challenge.
[*] Pickpocket Dwarfs got buffed.
[*] Overall music volume has been slightly lowered.
[*] Added weapon quality listing when forging weapons.
[*] Fixed positions of weapons during rune etching.
[*] Fixed bug with incorrect potion price.
[*] Fixed bug where potions are not properly added as a forging challenge reward.
[*] Improved visibility of dwarfs' HP in the tavern.
[*] Fixed bug where forging templates are displayed above your inventory panel when placed on the floor.
[/list]

[h3]Please keep the feedback coming so we can smooth up the experience even more![/h3]

notes.title: Blacksmith: Ignite the Forge is out NOW!
notes.content:
[p][/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfHWqXbH9OScXX-rKGtDxs5U0eEW2KUm-AxdXM-gL-m5PRi0eyioO2SsfcrNTGIKW3pCwkYxsJo-8jyVB-6xBUbgFbuiK_oEsPKMHQz3tLd53kxhjUCtyQQrsZFaR-X3xsG21bYQQ?key=xkK37QANMnm1CUr8ZEhavQ"][/img][/p][h2][b]Welcome, masterful Blacksmiths![/b][/h2][p]The time has come! After more than a year in development, we’re excited (and a bit stressed) to announce that [b]Blacksmith: Ignite the Forge is now officially released! 🛠️ [/b]And for a better start, we’re offering you a[b] 10% release discount![/b][/p][p]Watch the release trailer to get a glimpse of what the game has to offer:[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="tTxYKP5Gs7E;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Our hammers and anvils are hot as hell from all the work! It’s been an amazing journey for our small indie team here at Floodgate Crew. We learned a ton and made new friends, but most importantly, we feel we’ve crafted a cool game for you! The spark for this project came from a simple thought: there just aren’t enough games about being a blacksmith (like really being one). We wanted to make a game where you feel that the weapons you craft actually have an impact on the game’s world—a game we’d genuinely want to play ourselves. And now, it’s here![/p][p]To everyone who played the demo, joined the closed beta, and gave us honest feedback: THANK YOU. Your insights and support helped shape this game into something we're truly proud of. We’ve come a long way thanks to YOU, craftsmen! That goes without saying.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXe9EybAvRKNGts0DR-yTG-ffzXnODlQYWx3nUxl0JzMMzf8I-TijYywA_GFddsutBlcAIawt0zrgA2Lz9bw2NGWPQoAk3ddKeCCjuabwGcPK35gDQiNcifv2CuBzDLrYexIWQtpTw?key=xkK37QANMnm1CUr8ZEhavQ"][/img][/p][h2][b]Now, to the point![/b][/h2][p]In case it’s the first time you’re seeing our game, let’s give you a quick introduction. Blacksmith: Ignite the Forge is a mix of a simulator, strategy, and auto-battler. Become a master smith, craft various weapons, and enhance them with magical runes. Equip a team of adventurers with your hand-made tools, send them on missions, gather loot to upgrade your forge, and save the land![/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXeIk_yPfyffxq3eLZMFQkN7VqeG90uXiO0qWNwPMHFDz6G7HXDceWXYZDzF8Qqtwggm8jzYJ5USFRCimsEz3gI6-oA2BSPpsFpUYdtprhWt9rphPKga1yRjNu8BxtiaQsnQfpn3vg?key=xkK37QANMnm1CUr8ZEhavQ"][/img][/p][p][b]So, what awaits you in the full release in terms of content? And what has changed from the demo version? Take a look at the full list:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]12 ore types[/b] to experiment with alloy combinations and effects[/p][/*][*][p][b]27 weapon templates[/b] to forge, including [b]7 legendary weapons[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]5 forge tool upgrades[/b] to unlock new capabilities[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked rune enchanting system with [b]7 runes,[/b] each offering [b]5 magical effects[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]9 dwarf types,[/b] each with unique skills and personalities[/p][/*][*][p][b]3 story bosses[/b] + [b]4 optional mine bosses[/b] to challenge your skills[/p][/*][*][p][b]3 acts[/b] filled with smithing challenges and narrative beats[/p][/*][*][p][b]5 potions[/b] to power up your dwarves in battle[/p][/*][*][p][b]Improved visuals and environmental polish[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]All of that is fully localized into [b]English, Polish, Japanese, German, French, and Simplified & Traditional Chinese![/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcdfwfbzPUqL7vPitXT4C2Sr_SeQhuOgmJv40a2UW_VVW3gm4pWSXSCzgpLl2QqjfqC4fAsxZY1Ako807rkbTCOj1oHqw0Vo3UTiZJnB4xbR8AmfPn9thcq8Z-CGlLIwxQzexETiQ?key=xkK37QANMnm1CUr8ZEhavQ"][/img][/p][h2][b]For those who played the demo version[/b][/h2][p]Due to the extensive changes, fixes, and improvements made to the release version, demo save files will not carry over. We know that’s a bit of a bummer, and we’re truly sorry for the inconvenience. That said, the final version is a completely upgraded experience compared to the demo, with new systems, mechanics, and content that should make starting over a breath of fresh air![/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcPpop3_sf54mwIcALVs_N0OyTu918p0_p8TdKgb9H1xAtdTXyhUk9XwVrbg30gBmrz49H1gVUBo7pMIEeFA4Os862sTtV6YxZGfrZ1Lc74XIQJjJbGYqTZrzg-okyeT3PZ9rYdtw?key=xkK37QANMnm1CUr8ZEhavQ"][/img][/p][h2][b]Anything to report?[/b][/h2][p]We’ve tested the game extensively and we’re happy with its current state, but as always, bugs can sneak through (#indiegamedev all the way). If you encounter any issues or have suggestions, please post in the Steam Discussions or join us on Discord. We’ll be constantly on the lookout for your reports, and we’ll do our best to get rid of the issues ASAP![/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXdoO3-c7INfqxfKc4xoAdwKmxmnvaN9FFoTItv27epAz8vqSK3sYu48EW-OcQNHNBw98FwzemEsxX3LinZmIKmSjCk05XWi0dvbIoEOIQpB4bllouhxI56sldVqo5juGfjmNbolig?key=xkK37QANMnm1CUr8ZEhavQ"][/img][/p][h2][b]What’s next after launch?[/b][/h2][p]While we’re not planning any major content expansions at the moment, we’re definitely not done with the game. Post-launch, our focus will shift to adding extra layers of polish—that means ongoing bug fixes, quality-of-life tweaks, and audio improvements to enhance the overall experience. And after we’re finished, we’ll probably take a well-deserved break and then get to developing our next game![/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfWFl_60S-fQCpwSmuLEId1mYtFDWMVGV6Id7tVrR_1z3OHOG3kNrFvz3jnw4VsJTXYet5XRSGcj5Crh-NX4ylLHavqFafj4QCsIvtR9bPFBAZC93frLjKTMbfiswhdVZf4ej-rRA?key=xkK37QANMnm1CUr8ZEhavQ"][/img][/p][h2][b]Have fun playing![/b][/h2][p]That’s all for now! We really can’t wait for you to try the game out and share your feedback. We hope the gameplay will bring you a lot of fun (and a dose of strategic, tactical planning). The forge is lit, the hammers are hot, and the dwarves are ready to save the province from Chaos! There’s nothing left but to join in and lead the way, blacksmiths! [/p][p][/p][p][b]Cheers, and take care of your Forge!
Floodgate Crew / Awaken Realms[/b][/p][p][/p][p]
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2651220/Blacksmith_Ignite_the_Forge/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Stone and steel to you, Blacksmiths!
notes.content:
[p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45227734/1d92d9dafae28c957a444ffc71d8bb824fa6fe07.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Welcome to another development update for the game! 
[/h2][p]Let's begin this update with some exciting news: [/p][p][/p][h3][b]Blacksmith: Ignite the Forge launches July 14![/b] [/h3][p][/p][p]That's right, the release date is that close! Make sure to ready your hammers and heat the forge[/p][p][/p][p]As our team works on the final touches of the game, the forge grows eager for your arrival. We’ve worked tirelessly to provide you with the right tools, and so it is time for you to write the next chapter of dwarven legacy. [/p][p][/p][h2]New stuff in the Forge[/h2][p]With over 18 new (27 altogether) weapons for you to smith , sharpen, and enchant, nothing will stand in the path of your warriors. Take a peek at some of them!
[/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfvKt01jjMuFcSUl6z7qkdHk8Rc_hUNdU7R4zq_gJ00Kb_QAiOAF14KQwJarBQS8_i54UrBji1GaQdtFskK_DUAqrPXw52pSIv8flH-kzAGblOyxSwXJRpmZQrrGIvIYPMDiGG9hQ?key=-c0geqUaQhh_D004F09eag"][/img][/p][p]But there is more! You can now rebuild the forge to its former glory. Not only that. You can go beyond that! Craft meteor templates to upgrade the forge. Unlock all your possibilities. Face dangers both on the surface as well as from beneath the ground![/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXdhqc1xPXeJCRbeB01j32FNx667P4ipmwRwXim6zuEqq9wTa8t9cNMUdyNCCw01RyydrdvxTEBKPv6AQEehq7G5jFePO4z8l3Ah7777e9Unt8pe-4DABma6MFdQTpNCtX4T5YsK?key=-c0geqUaQhh_D004F09eag"][/img][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXesPGwHXL0--XOxW4zkqbEpE-PXBMlBa8gz2G-QW8v8oKWVaaMM_uUxUPDVFQdAZfTdRj7wqX8MljcGIGujLmupu0pQydVovjaHK-YfGC4MHboMLtjyeTorg7q68pVJaDzVokcY?key=-c0geqUaQhh_D004F09eag"][/img][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXerUSywU2UV8AKzrGUAK3wWiK7kWmwtVf0Q6WfPETy-VdoOK4YkH_lsTkM_-_tlF3pbdgt0FBxNX5rx92cpEciXQnbH5E_1F0sXXbiDb8zE_7VJeNHwD_wDMCgfN-Y75nfGywEFPQ?key=-c0geqUaQhh_D004F09eag"][/img][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXdYks5s92ynV2bQ5qusK6IXmOkuWdPP0ekCX9CNDoP6fWRFYVyKmgwt95Nl_A-mSEZyh9uckABX9D2-FhCVoGtxjf-K5ApqaYHvesKClOk-Xir3YPPpBbulfuok2_L8qjnTTCW4XQ?key=-c0geqUaQhh_D004F09eag"][/img][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcjThbwYf09tSjVVcgpoGG0QHQIxjxAZzoNgeraqoNX06Gt8p8iTPsCuSEa1OSfvP1PuY9knplpVD8c8NHgRHhpyLsJE5wQHkM94TT2FEWvGlBs6f70_IXOuLUyLE8izK1r3m7tHg?key=-c0geqUaQhh_D004F09eag"][/img][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXdcmIxq0b4UhDzk-_F7O_hTK1kBWfieEsMrV8ptPrHd1jOL7WZBLuxLDaBeY6iJg2RyePjrY8sVZS2RERM_FwJONP-LO8pvKKwvgVO_mtX_3FbXEkovfwH-DvjSL3Hs-K5aib0s?key=-c0geqUaQhh_D004F09eag"][/img][/p][p]As you go deeper into the mines, you’ll encounter 6 new ores: Orichalcum, Cobalt, Titanium, Zinc, Platinum, and Lead.[/p][h2]Bosses[/h2][p]Wouldn’t you agree that every story needs a proper fight after achieving certain milestones? The final battle can’t be just against some lackeys. Allow us to introduce you to some of our Big Bads.[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXeXCfFk2nstDQeyeTWrQ9YoJu2zXP9MBWHOL-e4lhrMOqmnacNhyonDtDNtlgVLNj_QgvjraXHTJ_HAOUp47Bz-MfjzYv-NRcKBFvnXOZRu14sM0EtRHaDijm1L74WX-FFltLbhWg?key=-c0geqUaQhh_D004F09eag"][/img][/p][h2]Forge renovations[/h2][p]As the game moved more toward dwarves, we realized that the steampunk aesthetic no longer fit the game that [i]Ignite the Forge[/i] became. We decided to renovate the original forge, and while the layout of the rooms remained unchanged, it now feels much more in place.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXdMXUDPa9WMslpec3N30ZtcB_83YZATSKFfC4MWVe2C-CXf9UwnPCoXQVUQgEsmegdlwxIP6zcoest9wUpjQMbSQvjVZa_URyEQrS9tsuHGyAP79PXVkkxffqTNS9wed6mTaW16?key=-c0geqUaQhh_D004F09eag"][/img][/p][h2]NPCs never looked so good[/h2][p]While the first graphics of the enemies were fine, we felt that we could do more. Without further ado, let us introduce you to the porks’ new clothes. And rats… AND our new race of enemies: the Abyssals![/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXf8Gvcon074pRnTsnxvrIll3vZtMDDZSzBULVs0ZPjiHw5L4nGVpp8HNDto6oLwoSEYKFPGD4-LYaFu3ijZUrD1CidLWCybsLJ9AegiCia1fbHVhygyk_drH3cVjORrbxjkWTHqCQ?key=-c0geqUaQhh_D004F09eag"][/img][/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXeEUENr00NaGQo-q3l9UOsPSIQf3jUMwoIynDNsd0KFs9fglX_E6-CbC8ONe_o6lDbidM7nE4-sQYUxO6cFvQWtM_0PKcRSf0BccqcUa3LFE8ARDUH1GHnH30Lgt47FQHb5cAU9kQ?key=-c0geqUaQhh_D004F09eag"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Don’t worry, though. Our foes aren’t the only ones. It’s only fair that we take care of the brave warriors, too.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXeLrNEX5MYC3FCI8xTfj_lDKyJx9gEGbMOmjF45r10aPlBMUkmXeTbOMpr4G_D8WXri3o44gklP0FgOmPtVH9gCXnYYjoQSmmKHEJ6Rr_98kdmAymzh0zhUuxiizbJjWUkCJdDvhA?key=-c0geqUaQhh_D004F09eag"][/img][/p][h2]Improved skills[/h2][p]Speaking of the warriors, during our development journey, we realized that the previous skills and leveling system didn’t do them justice. After experimenting with different ideas, we’ve made skills more meaningful. No longer just passive effects, now every skill has its own unique move as well as ways for you to tailor it to your team’s needs.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXeXVZmNIEcuurD1-LA1cKd0r4Nsq9cXUUm8qrcHJCTMHUfm5f4YHydAxiM1xr2-1tvDU2TyD1Bz-fUuXuHlQvGZsZFv9SLOM_C1NMqbIHyBTLv6uyUMtdMJdjplXxILSsKOCwPTwA?key=-c0geqUaQhh_D004F09eag"][/img][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXdcjCMzam-fC-uEH99626thqxvUs5GMWYaX0CK-uk0gsQlvDjpPIZ8iFbP2R2ykxEZYV6EYAF0rioUTjSzYYi9XebXLoIXE52v3rJQ4Si4OHUrh6qeN7phlItka2S-HH9u6kCMxSg?key=-c0geqUaQhh_D004F09eag"][/img][/p][h2]Thank you![/h2][p]Making this game was an amazing journey, and we’re thankful to you for being a part of it!
Tell us what you think in the comments section or join our Discord if you want to get in touch more directly: [/p][p][url="https://discord.com/invite/X6WNQUUJnx"]https://discord.com/invite/X6WNQUUJnx[/url][/p][p][/p][p]May your axe stay sharp,
Floodgate Crew / Awaken Realms[/p][p]

notes.title: Demo Revamp Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45227734/3688f9f07c217e15c285ab944db975307c0a46dd.jpg[/img]

[h2]THE NEW BIG DEMO UPDATE IS LIVE! ⚒️[/h2]

Today we’re releasing an update for the demo version of Blacksmith: Ignite the Forge! This is a[b] HUGE[/b] improvement for us, with highly requested features, new content, and quality-of-life improvements.

Finally, the forge is starting to look like professional dwarven machinery! We also have a new sharpening minigame that will put your smithing skills to the test! 💪

[b]We can’t wait to hear what you think about the new stuff! If you can’t wait anymore, go ahead and download the update! And if you’re a little more patient, below is more info about the improvements ;)[/b]

[h2]Save system[/h2]
We know a lot of you have been waiting for this… And here you go! You can now save your progress and jump back into your forge whenever you like without losing your hard work.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45227734/447a9028613011c59e9491a52829b5026328e6b8.jpg[/img]

[h2]Whetstone & weapon sharpening[/h2]
This is a brand-new, risk-reward-based system. You have to commit some of your resources to access the sharpening minigame. If you succeed, your weapon becomes stronger. At the same time, failure damages it, makes it weaker, and loses both your time and precious supplies. No risk, no fun, right?

[previewyoutube=jD2kMYIUWVI;full][/previewyoutube]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45227734/e391debfb42e148b2de471efd90895d499db5ef0.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45227734/5ac85b022b0835322624303f789ab350523e20af.jpg[/img]

[h2]New weapons & missions[/h2]
Simple as that, we’re adding more content to the game. You’ll be able to forge new weapons (swords and axes) and embark on 7+ new quests! Below you can see some examples (some of these are already in the game; other will be added in the future).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45227734/ee5962f821a278279fc0a7ae1e6bbe5707d8c200.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45227734/0f0b8285f667bb9bf489d1f001630201f4eea3d4.jpg[/img]

[h2]Dwarven forge makeover[/h2]
We want the game to resemble a deeper dwarven aesthetic, and the new look of the forge is our starting point for that. How do you like the change?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45227734/cfb3e5fd244ee26ad44675ef649c73e272e5127d.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45227734/7f6a563fdaec05cf5fb18a1339cf5cadbace4ee6.jpg[/img]

[h2]Reworked combat flow[/h2]
We’re reimagining the combat system for better readability. The mechanics & rules stay unchanged, but the new semi-turn-based presentation makes battles easier to follow. There’s less clutter, and knowing what’s actually going on is easier.

[previewyoutube=FXHDqDBytKU;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Weapon forging improvement[/h2]
While it’s hard to pinpoint the exact changes, forging weapons should now feel more intuitive, responsive, and fun in general. Try yourselves!

[h2]More polish[/h2]
And for the gamedev’s bread and butter, we’ve also squashed bugs, tuned mechanics, and made minor enhancements across the board.

[h2]Sneak peeks from the future[/h2]
Apart from the things that go live with today’s update, we have tons of plans for the game’s future. While we explained that in detail in our latest Steam post, we have some new sneak peeks for you:

[previewyoutube=7M2WCUO-dME;full][/previewyoutube]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45227734/be8eb0eee8e4041a03e93cd857e9c016131a97fc.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Development plan for Blacksmith: Ignite the Forge
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45227734/ea7509ea60f785e563928ae75e09a08aa61e7f88.jpg[/img]

[h2]Hello, Blacksmiths![/h2]

It’s been some time since we released the demo version of Blacksmith: Ignite the Forge, and we wanted to share some of our thoughts with you.

Let us start with a [b]HUGE THANK YOU![/b] Your engagement, tons of feedback provided, and kind words about the game have all been truly appreciated and helpful. We’re especially happy that you find the game's theme appealing, and see a lot of potential for the future. That motivates us to deliver the best (and most fun) smithing experience on Steam! ⚒️

[previewyoutube=5c7s_rr7cRU;full][/previewyoutube]

Now for the highlight of this post: we’d like to share our plans for the development process of Blacksmith: Ignite the Forge! Without further introductions, take a look:

[h2]Updated demo coming later this year[/h2]

Many of you enjoyed the first glimpse of Blacksmith: Ignite the Forge, and we’ll be releasing an updated version of the demo later this year. You can expect various new features (mostly quality-of-life-related), including the save system many of you mentioned.

[h2]First major update: combat overhaul[/h2]

We agree with your opinions: combat needs a revamp to be more interactive and fun. We’re working on making fights more dynamic, rewarding, and lively, to improve the general experience. Overhauling this system is our main focus now, and we hope you’ll like the changes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45227734/3873dffe146be8d398e5c7d0b02c6a799be9beae.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45227734/4ac4469b927c8913376b2abb4c3e02229f61ebe8.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45227734/d3f1eb8f2d47d04e829ebfa6d85c621b38f83d16.jpg[/img]

Additionally, reworked combat means new enemies, and that includes bosses! We’re preparing grand challenges for you, and this guy will be one of them:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45227734/d83c69c8379a12b4caed65a128829fc3cc943e2d.jpg[/img]

Other than combat, there’s tons of stuff coming, but again: one Steam post wouldn’t be enough to keep that covered, so stay tuned and expect more info about that in the next updates.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45227734/f7c0984d43fb79db101cd8fd54c29e4364fff310.jpg[/img]

[h2]Monthly devlogs incoming[/h2]

We have a plan to release a devlog every month to keep you in the loop on our development process and showcase some highlights of the current works. Gamedev is tricky and sometimes hard to predict, so please forgive us in case we’re late with those 🙏.

[h2]Improvements based on your feedback[/h2]

For us this is a no-brainer: all of the feedback you provided was, and will always be, taken into account. We can’t implement each and every change or tweak you propose, obviously, but rest assured that your voices are heard. Make sure to join our Discord and keep the feedback going!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45227734/dd8cae4fd26fe273cd61e700b063c6a3e1899f78.jpg[/img]

Sneak peek for the more engaged ones: the bug with the crate weapon will actually become a full-fledged feature, following your requests! Enjoy the extra 3 seconds saved 😎.

[h2]Playtests incoming[/h2]

We’re preparing to run playtests for some of the bigger features we have planned. If you’re interested in trying them out early and providing feedback, sign up using the form below. There are a total of 3 playtests planned, each covering a different major area of the game.
Registration form:[url=https://forms.gle/mUnhEa94PjFcSGH88] LINK[/url]

[h2]Behind-the-scenes concept art[/h2]

Throughout this whole post, we’ve shown you some sneak peeks of the upcoming content additions and changes, and here are more. New weapons, enemies, attack animations, runes, the revamped alloy machine–and that’s just to name a few of them. Eventually, our goal is for the final version to be as polished as possible, so we want to smoothen things up and make them more appealing in terms of visuals. Many of those were also inspired by your feedback!

[i]*Disclaimer: those are subject to change, but give a good feeling of the planned art direction.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45227734/47cce1685b05231aa95efac656b2bb9df34fb515.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45227734/fff9e99b23bf26a7d1c3e7fc7aba33f2e1da846b.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45227734/6ae0f408e2506ac15056b1ee5b28223a37094d71.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45227734/0cf9a2a85fb08b6e2d1f1762f46b56b243e14a79.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45227734/574dfac5af44a2b3ed982834d7a5928d33d8771c.jpg[/img]

[h2]That’s a wrap for now![/h2]

Once again, thank you for all the support and sticking with us through the process. Feel free to share your thoughts about this post or the game itself. Watch out for the next development updates, and join our Discord to provide feedback, have a chat, or just hang around: [url=https://discord.com/invite/X6WNQUUJnx]https://discord.com/invite/X6WNQUUJnx[/url]
On our Discord server, we sometimes post some exclusive behind-the-scenes content for members only, so make sure you don’t miss it!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3209890/Blacksmith_Ignite_the_Forge_Demo/
